typewriterLines: I train language models from scratch.
From Kathmandu to Hildesheim — shipping ML.
about: I build ML/AI & Data Analytics systems end-to-end —> from pretraining transformer architectures on raw corpora to deploying analytics pipelines in production. My research at NAAMII focused on imbalanced clinical cancer data, resulting in a published IEEE paper on radiation pneumonitis prediction using multi-omics approaches.

On the engineering side, I've shipped ML solutions for real businesses, designed medallion-architecture data pipelines, and automated analytical workflows using LLM-based agents. My flagship project, PIGPT-60M, is a 60-million parameter GPT I designed, trained, and fine-tuned entirely from scratch.
I'm currently pursuing my MSc in Data Analytics at the University of Hildesheim. Originally from Nepal, now based in Germany — chasing hard problems in AI and building things that actually work.

projects.name: NovaMind-256M
projects.description: Designed and trained a 256 million parameter model with mixed architecture from top open source language models on Lightning.ai's H100 GPU. Implemented full training pipeline: pre-training on FineWeb-Edu + TinyStories, fine-tuning on Alpaca + DailyDialog + ShareGPT for instruction following, and OpenHermes-2.5 + GSM8K for CoT.
